global_rules.rule: NEVER generate new voiceover. Extract from existing videos and adjust visuals to match. This saves 44% of credits.
global_rules.violated_by: Attempting to generate voiceover with ElevenLabs without explicit user request
global_rules.how_to_follow: Always check for existing audio files first. If regeneration is required, ask user permission explicitly.

global_rules.rule: LOCKED: Never hardcode SYSTEM_PROMPT, animation prompts, or instructions inside code. Extract to versioned prompt files in prompts/{name}.txt
global_rules.violated_by: System prompts or instructions embedded in Python code instead of external files
global_rules.how_to_follow: All prompts must live in prompts/ directory. Code must load via _load_prompt(PROMPTS_DIR / 'name.txt')

global_rules.rule: LOCKED: Never delete prompts/, tests/, or .claude/ directories. Infrastructure deletion = data loss.
global_rules.violated_by: Attempted deletion or cleanup of infrastructure directories
global_rules.how_to_follow: These directories are inviolable. Mark items xfail/skip if needed, but never delete the structure.

global_rules.rule: Frame count formula: frames = VO_seconds × 30fps (max +30 buffer). Verify before render.
global_rules.violated_by: Rendering without verifying Root.tsx durationInFrames matches calculated frame count
global_rules.how_to_follow: For 120s VO: 120 × 30 = 3600 frames. Check Remotion composition before rendering.

global_rules.rule: SVG diagrams: ViewBox minimum 850px height for 7-node radials. Labels below circles need 60px clearance.
global_rules.violated_by: Text cutoff in rendered diagrams due to insufficient viewBox height
global_rules.how_to_follow: All SVG components must include viewBox='0 0 1920 850' minimum for complex layouts.

global_rules.rule: LOCKED: Always verify VO-to-visual sync BEFORE final mux. Run spot-checks on 3+ frame offsets.
global_rules.how_to_follow: Test captions display at correct frames. Verify voiceover aligns with visual moments.

global_rules.rule: LOCKED: Commit submodule FIRST, then main repo pointer. Opposite order = lost work.
global_rules.violated_by: Committing main repo before submodule changes are pushed
global_rules.how_to_follow: 1. Commit drawing-room-video/ submodule changes. 2. Then commit main repo with updated submodule pointer.

global_rules.rule: LOCKED: Never force-push to main. Ever. This destroys history.
global_rules.violated_by: Using git push --force or git reset --hard on main branch
global_rules.how_to_follow: Always merge or rebase cleanly. If conflicts occur, resolve manually.

global_rules.rule: LOCKED: pytest is mandatory. Never remove from requirements.txt. Run before every commit.
global_rules.violated_by: Removing pytest or skipping test execution
global_rules.how_to_follow: Run `pytest` locally. All tests must pass before marking task complete.

global_rules.rule: Final videos go in updated/ folder. Intermediate renders in video_production/{production_id}/
global_rules.violated_by: Saving final videos to incorrect directories
global_rules.how_to_follow: Intermediate: video_production/ → Final: updated/ (with VO muxed)

RemotionVideoAgent.rule: LOCKED: durationInFrames must match VO duration exactly. 1 second late = quality issue.
RemotionVideoAgent.violated_by: Composition duration doesn't match voiceover length
RemotionVideoAgent.how_to_follow: Calculate: frames = VO_seconds × 30fps. Set durationInFrames in composition.

RemotionVideoAgent.rule: Composition IDs can only contain a-z, A-Z, 0-9, CJK, and hyphens. NO underscores.
RemotionVideoAgent.violated_by: Composition IDs with underscores cause Remotion validation errors

RemotionVideoAgent.rule: All animated segments must have smooth transitions (no jarring cuts unless explicitly requested).
RemotionVideoAgent.violated_by: Animation glitches or rough transitions in preview
RemotionVideoAgent.how_to_follow: Test in Remotion Studio. Verify opacity/scale animations are smooth.

PostProductionAgent.rule: LOCKED: Captions must display at EXACT frame offsets matching voiceover script timing.
PostProductionAgent.violated_by: Captions appear early/late relative to spoken words
PostProductionAgent.how_to_follow: Map each caption to exact frame from VO script. Test before muxing.

PostProductionAgent.rule: Final audio must be AAC (not mp3, not pcm_s16le). H.264 + AAC is the only compatible combo.
PostProductionAgent.violated_by: Audio codec mismatch causing sync issues or unplayable files

PostProductionAgent.rule: LOCKED: Never render videos with blank frames after audio ends. Trim to match VO duration exactly.
PostProductionAgent.violated_by: Final video has black silence after voiceover ends

DistributionAgent.rule: All YouTube titles and descriptions must match course schema exactly (no improvisation).
DistributionAgent.how_to_follow: Use title, description from VideoProductionConfig schema. No custom variations.

DistributionAgent.rule: LOCKED: Always validate LMS payload against schema BEFORE pushing. Invalid JSON = silently dropped.
DistributionAgent.violated_by: LMS upload succeeds but video doesn't appear (silent failure)
DistributionAgent.how_to_follow: Validate payload structure matches SessionAssetBundle schema exactly.

DistributionAgent.rule: Log every upload with timestamp, destination, video_id, and status. Audit trail is immutable.
DistributionAgent.violated_by: Unable to trace which videos were uploaded where
DistributionAgent.how_to_follow: Write to distribution_audit.jsonl: {timestamp, agent, video_id, destination, status}

RemotionVideoAgent.error: Composition id can only contain a-z, A-Z, 0-9, CJK characters and -
RemotionVideoAgent.fix_applied: Renamed all composition IDs to use hyphens instead of underscores
RemotionVideoAgent.prevent_next_time: Check Root.tsx composition IDs match regex: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$

RemotionVideoAgent.error: 404 - Audio files not found during render. Webpack bundle couldn't locate /voiceover/ paths.
RemotionVideoAgent.root_cause: Audio files needed to be in public/ directory for webpack bundler access
RemotionVideoAgent.fix_applied: Abandoned Remotion Audio embedding; switched to external ffmpeg mux instead
RemotionVideoAgent.prevent_next_time: Don't embed audio in Remotion. Use post-production ffmpeg mux with proven pipeline.

RemotionVideoAgent.error: Text labels cut off at edges of SVG diagrams
RemotionVideoAgent.root_cause: SVG viewBox too small (600px height instead of 850px for 7-node radials)
RemotionVideoAgent.fix_applied: Updated all SVG components to use viewBox='0 0 1920 850' minimum
RemotionVideoAgent.prevent_next_time: All diagrams with 7+ nodes need minimum 850px viewBox height.

RemotionVideoAgent.error: 'ffmpeg' is not recognized as an internal or external command
RemotionVideoAgent.root_cause: ffmpeg binary not in PATH; script tried direct 'ffmpeg' call
RemotionVideoAgent.fix_applied: Use require('@ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg').path to locate binary; npm install @ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg
RemotionVideoAgent.prevent_next_time: Always use npm package for ffmpeg; never assume system PATH has it.

RemotionVideoAgent.error: Muxed video doesn't play in all browsers; audio sync is off
RemotionVideoAgent.root_cause: Used pcm_s16le audio codec with H.264 video; incompatible combo
RemotionVideoAgent.fix_applied: Changed to AAC codec for final mux: `ffmpeg ... -c:a aac ...`
RemotionVideoAgent.prevent_next_time: Only use H.264 + AAC combination for final output files.

PostProductionAgent.error: Captions displayed 2-3 seconds early/late relative to voiceover
PostProductionAgent.root_cause: Caption frame offsets calculated without accounting for Sequence timing
PostProductionAgent.fix_applied: Synchronized all captions using exact frame offsets from voiceover script
PostProductionAgent.prevent_next_time: Always map captions to exact VO script frame positions. Test 3+ spot-checks before final mux.

PostProductionAgent.error: Final video has 5 seconds of black silence after voiceover ends
PostProductionAgent.root_cause: Remotion composition duration (3600 frames) was longer than VO (3450 frames)
PostProductionAgent.fix_applied: Verified frame count formula and adjusted composition to match VO duration exactly
PostProductionAgent.prevent_next_time: Use -shortest flag in ffmpeg; always verify composition durationInFrames = VO_seconds × 30

PostProductionAgent.error: Caption skill failed silently; no SRT file generated but process continued
PostProductionAgent.root_cause: Missing error handling for caption generation failures
PostProductionAgent.fix_applied: Added explicit checks: if srt_path is None, log warning and use fallback captions
PostProductionAgent.prevent_next_time: Always validate intermediate outputs before proceeding to next stage.

DistributionAgent.error: YouTube upload silently skipped; YOUTUBE_API_KEY was None
DistributionAgent.root_cause: No check for API key availability before attempting upload
DistributionAgent.fix_applied: Added explicit log and skip when YOUTUBE_API_KEY is missing
DistributionAgent.prevent_next_time: Always validate API keys before uploading. Log success/skip status explicitly.

DistributionAgent.error: LMS API returned 200 but video never appeared on platform (silent failure)
DistributionAgent.root_cause: Payload validation was skipped; malformed JSON accepted by API without error
DistributionAgent.fix_applied: Added strict schema validation before LMS API call
DistributionAgent.prevent_next_time: Validate SessionAssetBundle payload against schema. Log validation errors explicitly.

DistributionAgent.error: Unable to trace which videos were uploaded to which platforms
DistributionAgent.root_cause: No audit logging for distribution actions
DistributionAgent.fix_applied: Implemented distribution_audit.jsonl with every upload event
DistributionAgent.prevent_next_time: Always log to audit trail with timestamp, destination, video_id, status.
